1.web: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.
1.asv: Be ye therefore imitators of God, as beloved children;

2.web: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.
2.asv: and walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for an odor of a sweet smell.

3.web: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;
3.asv: But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be named among you, as becometh saints;

4.web: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.
4.asv: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, or jesting, which are not befitting: but rather giving of thanks.

5.web: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.
5.asv: For this ye know of a surety, that no fornicator, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, hath any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and God.

6.web: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.
6.asv: Let no man deceive you with empty words: for because of these things cometh the wrath of God upon the sons of disobedience.

7.web: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.
7.asv: Be not ye therefore partakers with them;

8.web: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
8.asv: for ye were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord: walk as children of light

9.web: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,
9.asv: (for the fruit of the light is in all goodness and righteousness and truth),

10.web: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.
10.asv: proving what is well-pleasing unto the Lord;

11.web: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.
11.asv: and have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them;

12.web: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.
12.asv: for the things which are done by them in secret it is a shame even to speak of.

13.web: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.
13.asv: But all things when they are reproved are made manifest by the light: for everything that is made manifest is light.

14.web: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
14.asv: Wherefore he saith, Awake, thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall shine upon thee.

15.web: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;
15.asv: Look therefore carefully how ye walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

16.web: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
16.asv: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

17.web: Therefore don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.
17.asv: Wherefore be ye not foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

18.web: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,
18.asv: And be not drunken with wine, wherein is riot, but be filled with the Spirit;

19.web: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
19.asv: speaking one to another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody with your heart to the Lord;

20.web: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;
20.asv: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

21.web: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.
21.asv: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

22.web: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
22.asv: Wives, be in subjection unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.

23.web: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.
23.asv: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the church, being himself the saviour of the body.

24.web: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.
24.asv: But as the church is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their husbands in everything.

25.web: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;
25.asv: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself up for it;

26.web: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,
26.asv: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

27.web: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without defect.
27.asv: that he might present the church to himself a glorious church, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

28.web: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.
28.asv: Even so ought husbands also to love their own wives as their own bodies. He that loveth his own wife loveth himself:

29.web: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;
29.asv: for no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourisheth and cherisheth it, even as Christ also the church;

30.web: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.
30.asv: because we are members of his body.

31.web: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.”
31.asv: For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall cleave to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh.

32.web: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.
32.asv: This mystery is great: but I speak in regard of Christ and of the church.

33.web: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.
33.asv: Nevertheless do ye also severally love each one his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she fear her husband.
